summary: This sermon teaches that biblical generosity flows from viewing God as a generous creator and provider. The pastor contrasts an 'abundance mindset' (trusting God's provision) with a 'scarcity mindset' (hoarding out of fear or greed), arguing that storing up treasures in heaven through kingdom-focused generosity leads to the security and joy we truly seek.
key_points: Store up treasures in heaven, not on earth where they decay
Where your treasure is, there your heart will be also
A 'good eye' (generous spirit) reflects an abundance mindset; a 'bad eye' reflects scarcity
You cannot serve both God and money
One practical step: commit one act of spontaneous generosity this week
big_idea: True security and joy come not from accumulating earthly wealth but from trusting God as a generous provider and living generously for His kingdom.
title: GENEROSITY: There is More Joy in Giving Than Receiving
